prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Calibrating Desktop Companion Audio", "Test your pet's voice and alert sounds while your companion is being created.", "Test Voice Sound", "Preparing desktop sound environment..."]
1: ["Signing in links your pet to cloud backup, ensuring your companion is safe and never reset."]
2: ["Choose How to Create Your Desktop Pet", "Select a ready-to-go companion or build a custom pet tailored for your desktop workspace."]
3: ["Calibrate Your Custom Companion", "Adjust photo alignment to ensure accurate 3D pet generation on your desktop.", "Upload Photo", "Photo Alignment Preview"]
4: ["Secure Your Desktop Companion", "Sign in to keep your pet synced and safe across all your computers.", "Sign In with Account", "Cloud Save & Sync Active"]
5: ["Managing Your Companion on Desktop", "Your pet lives right in your system tray! Click the tray icon anytime to summon, hide, or configure your companion.", "System Tray Active", "Got It!"]
6: ["Finalizing pet registration and saving adoption certificate..."]
7: ["Feel free to work on other tasks! We will alert you the moment your desktop pet is ready."]
8: ["Select Your Ideal Desktop Companion", "Browse and pick the desktop friend that best matches your workspace style.", "Featured Companion Presets"]
9: ["Welcome Your New Companion!", "Your pet is officially on your desktop. Interact with your companion now to unlock your Inaugural Companion Badge!", "Reward: Inaugural Desktop Badge"]
